lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x₀
  by_contra hx₀
  have hc := Continuous.inner' f (fun _ => f x₀) hf continuous_const
  have hpos : 0 < ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ :=
    real_inner_self_nonneg'.lt_of_ne' (inner_self_eq_zero'.not.mpr hx₀)
  obtain ⟨r, hr, h⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp
    (hc.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (Ioi_mem_nhds hpos))
  let φ : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨r / 2, r, half_pos hr, half_lt_self hr⟩
  have hn : 0 ≤ (fun x => φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ r
    · exact mul_nonneg φ.nonneg (h hx).le
    · rw [φ.zero_of_le_dist (le_of_not_gt hx), zero_mul]
  have hp := (φ.continuous.mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
    φ.hasCompactSupport.mul_right hn
    (mul_ne_zero (φ.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)).ne' hpos.ne')
  exact hp.ne' (by simpa only [inner_smul_right'] using
    hg (fun x => φ x • f x₀)
      (IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨φ.contDiff, φ.hasCompactSupport⟩ contDiff_const))
